# Pet.uy

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online pet shop selling dog and cat food, snacks and cat litter from brands such as Pro Plan, Eukanuba, Pedigree, Hill's and Whiskas, retail and wholesale. Its site states deliveries within the day in Montevideo and within 72 hours to the rest of the country.
